title: Quickstart visuals rework: contrast & iconography audit for dark + light onboarding
creator: Marco Ruiz
description: Perform a full accessibility and dark-mode pass over Quickstart/onboarding UX assets and docs visuals. Deliver updated Figma components, dual-theme screenshots, and guidance for engineers and docs on which tokens to use. Focus areas: contrast ratios for text and graphical icons, icon legibility at small sizes, color token mapping, and screenshot production for docs and marketing releases.
acceptance_criteria: All onboarding text and CTA colors meet WCAG AA 4.5:1 for normal text or 3:1 for large text in both light and dark themes
All onboarding icons and illustrative glyphs meet 3:1 contrast ratio against background or have sufficient outlining/shadows to be legible at 16px
Figma library contains updated components with :light and :dark variants and annotated color tokens (e.g., token:onboard-bg, token:onboard-cta)
Exported screenshots for Quickstart flows in light/dark modes committed to docs repo with correct alt text and filenames
Design sign-off from Accessibility lead and PM approval before handoff to engineering
design_notes: Reference current Quickstart frames in Figma page 'Quickstart / 2026 Refresh'. Run Color Contrast Analyzer and Figma plugin 'Able - Color Contrast' to produce per-layer contrast report. For small icons (<18px), prefer filled glyphs with 12-14% border or 1px stroke with token:onboard-icon to maintain legibility. Avoid using pure white (#FFFFFF) on near-white backgrounds; use token:onboard-surface-foreground instead. Consider adding subtle backdrop blur or 6% overlay to hero screenshots in dark mode to increase contrast against UI chrome.
deliverables: Figma: Quickstart component library updated with light/dark variants (file: Figma/Redwood/Onboarding-2026)
Exports: PNG and SVG icon sets for onboarding (sizes: 16/24/32px) in both themes
Screenshots: 8 canonical Quickstart screenshots (light/dark x desktop/mobile x 2 flows) exported at 2x and added to docs repo
Docs PR: updates to /docs/quickstart with new screenshots and alt text
Design doc: A11y checklist and token mapping (linked in 'links' field)
qa_checks: Contrast report attached in Figma (pass threshold set to 4.5 for body text)
Manual verification on macOS (Light/Dark toggles) and iOS simulator for mobile screenshots
Color blindness simulation (Protanopia/Deutan/Tritanopia) — ensure no critical information relies on red/green hue alone
Keyboard focus state visible for CTA and primary controls in screenshots where applicable

tasks: Audit current Quickstart frames and create issue list with failing layers (assigned to Lina)
Update color tokens and create light/dark variants in Figma components
Iterate icon glyphs: introduce filled variants and 1px strokes where needed
Export icon sets and screenshots, compress/optimize assets
Open docs PR with updated screenshots and alt text, request engineering review for token names
decisions: Adopt token:onboard-surface-foreground instead of pure white on light surfaces to improve contrast
Use filled icons for sizes <= 18px to ensure legibility; outline variants stay for decorative use >= 24px
Include explicit screenshot guidelines in docs (device pixel ratio, padding, shallow depth-of-field blur to emphasize UI)

Accessibility sign-off and move ticket to 'In Review' once PR is created
